title: Moving Company Franchise Opportunity
tagline: Shubh Kali Packers and Movers Private Limited is a Patna-based packers & movers incorporated in 2022. Operating under the Shubh Kali Packers & Movers brand, we serve residential and business customers with local and long-distance moving services across India. All packages originate from Bihar and are transported across India. Our service model covers assessing customers’ requirements, preparing customised quotations, packing, loading, transportation, unloading and unpacking. Our key selling points include comprehensive relocation support, competitive pricing, protective packing materials, goods insurance assistance and round-the-clock phone support. A prospective franchise partner could serve household and commercial relocation requirements through the brand’s range of moving, transportation services. We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified Private Limited Company with GST registration.
